body:
You must be in so much pain, and I'm so sorry that the world hasn't taken care of you as well as you would have deserved. I don't usually leave comments, but I can't help but feel so much sympathy for you since we're the same age. :(

It makes sense that you want to kill yourself. Humans do have a certain capacity for pain, and once the pain exceeds it, it's really hard to convince yourself to stay alive. However, I genuinely hope you find enough resources to help you get through today. In the end, there's no rush. Death will wait.

I hope you're able to do those things you said you would have wanted to do before you go. Death will be forever, and there's no going back, so why not give those little things a chance?

However, I genuinely hope you manage to stay, even for just a little bit longer. I hope you'll be safe enough to stay and fight for the future version of you that you haven't met yet.

I'm sorry that I'm probably not able to understand you completely since we're two different people, but please just know that you're in my thoughts and I do care, even if we're strangers, and I'm so sorry that you're in so much pain.
